title: President Signs Grain to Alcohol Production Bill
reason: The video describes the signing of a bill and a trade agreement, which are real-world actions.

tasks.task: The President signs a bill enabling the Department of Agriculture to convert grain into alcohol for fuel use.

subtasks.text: The President states the purpose of the bill, which is to enable the Department of Agriculture to take grain in storage and convert it into alcohol for fuel use.
The President explains that this bill will help by reducing the threat to legitimate grain pricing due to the large stock of government-held grain.
The President prepares to sign the bill.
The President signs the bill and states that it is now law.

tasks.task: The President announces a trade agreement that will benefit the American steel industry.

subtasks.text: The President discusses the negotiated agreement that will restrain European steel exports to the United States.
The President explains that the agreement will cover 90 percent of steel imports from Europe and relieve unfair competition.
The President mentions that the agreement will mean more and lasting jobs in the steel industry.
The President describes what will happen in return for the agreement on imports.
The President commends the negotiators for their efforts.
